correctness.rationale: Substitution into the operator Nijenhuis identity gives the exact alternating scalar identity φ∧(φ∘ad_u)=φ(u)φ∘[,]. For φ nonzero on the derived space, surjectivity kerφ→V forces φ(u)=0; using a central argument forces φ∘ad_u=0, yielding an iff classification. The wedge rank n−1, four linear-vector choices and q−1 factorization divisor give the stated count. Trace N=φ(u), N²=φ(u)N and the asymptotic ratio follow exactly. Exhaustive torsion testing over five prime-field configurations and direct operator testing over GF(4) confirm 554023 factor pairs, not serving as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Rank-one Nijenhuis operators are a motivated minimal-rank integrable deformation class on nilpotent Lie algebras. The full natural free-two-step family yields an exact enumeration and a structural correspondence with radicals of alternating forms, separating character-type and derived-sensitive solutions. The sharp generator-rank-3 appearance and fixed-field asymptotic dominance of the latter are genuine unbounded-family structural information beyond the basic torsion criterion and beyond central-image constructions. Does not assert external applications or higher-rank results.
